presets.name: tutorial
presets.why: SPHEREx tutorial field; dense QR2 coverage for first paint.

presets.name: barnards-star
presets.why: Highest proper-motion star (~10.3 arcsec/yr); moves ~0.03 arcsec/day, under the static-source threshold. Baked on detector 5 (best of three detectors tried — see the field comment) — validation recall 0.94 but on only 3 frames/variant C, and the ~31 candidates are mostly real static sources in this crowded field (25-cap truncation applies). Treat the recall as best-of-three, not unbiased.

presets.name: epsilon-indi-b
presets.why: Epsilon Indi Ba brown dwarf (~53 Mjup), ~3.6 pc; offset from Ind A.

presets.name: wise-0855
presets.why: WISE 0855-0714 Y-dwarf (~250 K), ~2.3 pc, ~8 arcsec/yr proper motion; same static-flag expectation as Barnard's Star.

presets.name: rw-aur
presets.why: RW Aurigae A/B T Tauri binary with episodic dimming; slow mover.

presets.name: r-dra
presets.why: R Draconis Mira variable; densest QR3 field (723 frames) — the field/window above keeps search and validation under ORB-RS-003.
